items.title: TFI International: 3 Key Takeaways for Long-Term Investors
items.summary: TFI International reported Q3 2026 adjusted diluted EPS of $1.67 and $116 million in free cash flow. The company is improving truckload profitability through asset efficiency, addressing operational challenges in its U.S. less-than-truckload business through management changes, and expanding its high-margin asset-light logistics segment. Management expects favorable conditions in 2027 as demand recovers while industry fleet supply remains constrained.

items.title: TFI International Inc. (TFII) Q3 Earnings Miss Estimates
items.summary: TFI International reported Q3 2026 earnings of $1.67 per share, missing the consensus estimate of $1.75, though revenues exceeded expectations at $2.23 billion. The company received a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating due to unfavorable estimate revisions. The Transportation - Services industry ranks in the bottom 20% of Zacks industries, suggesting broader sector weakness.

items.title: Compared to Estimates, TFI International (TFII) Q3 Earnings: A Look at Key Metrics
items.summary: TFI International reported Q3 2026 revenue of $2.23 billion, up 13.4% year-over-year, slightly beating the consensus estimate of $2.21 billion. However, EPS of $1.67 missed expectations of $1.75, representing a -4.57% surprise. The company's Adjusted Operating Ratio came in at 89.5%, slightly above the 89% estimate. The stock has underperformed the broader market, declining 6.5% over the past month, and carries a Zacks Rank #4 (Sell) rating.
